_what: Minimal VERBATIM fragments of REAL cached pages, for tests/test_not_a_pdp_filter.py (UNIT F1). Every <title>, canonical, og:url and ld+json block below is copied out of the cached bytes unchanged; only the surrounding <html>/<head>/<body> skeleton is added, and what was dropped is named per file.
_measurement: E1 census (scratchpad m8/E1/not_a_pdp_table.json + census_final.json): 61 of 422 corpus rows were never product pages.
